ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for functions, domain, range and inverse.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: A function assigns exactly one output to each input in its domain.
The range is the set of outputs actually obtained from the stated domain.
An inverse function reverses input and output when the original function is one-to-one on its domain.

misc.weak: Taking a square root as the inverse of $x^2$ on all real inputs
misc.better: Restrict the original domain to make the function one-to-one.

terms.text: Give a reason that connects the mathematical idea to the situation.
Show enough working to make your method and answer clear.

worked.prompt: For $f(x)=x^2$ with $x\ge0$, state its range and inverse.

parts.label: Solution
parts.a: The range is $[0,\infty)$ and $f^{-1}(x)=\sqrt x$ for $x\ge0$.

kq.q: What mistake should I check for?
kq.model: Restrict the original domain to make the function one-to-one.
